description: A 'fight the rats' bot loads an empty gun from the cargo before it fires. A Vexor with one empty railgun, ammunition in the cargo and no drones runs a bot of one 'fight the rats' step against a rat off the station's grid. A block with no reload presses the empty gun every tick and is refused NoCharges (issue 181).
